title: rosa canina f. mucronulata
intro: Rosa canina f. mucronulata, commonly known as wild rose hips, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant is a variation of the rose species Rosa canina, known for its edible fruits that are rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. The health benefits of Rosa canina f. mucronulata include supporting immune function, reducing inflammation, and providing antioxidant protection due to its high content of vitamin C, vitamin A, and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive constituents, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
